lines: Srinath Ramakkrushnan, a Promoter Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 14,230,672 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹214.88 crore are scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer document, not yet confirmed.
The event was 23 days ago, so the listing timing still rests on the scheduled date rather than a confirmed notice.
Caveat: the average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding are not confirmed, so gain and retained value are unknown.
